overview: The Medford City Council approved a $23.6 million loan order for the Roberts Elementary School roof and HVAC replacement, passed the FY27 tax classification maintaining a 175% commercial tax shift, and voted to approve a supplemental Law Department appropriation alongside a request for a state audit of city legal expenditures.

items.title: Ward 2 Neighborhood Meeting Announcement and Records Approval
items.summary: The Council approved a resolution inviting residents to a Ward 2 Neighborhood Meeting on December 2 and approved the meeting records from November 10.

items.title: Tufts Park Master Plan Request
items.summary: The Council referred a resolution requesting a master plan to coordinate parallel infrastructure and park improvement projects at Tufts Park to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Expansion Master Plan Request
items.summary: Following public comment regarding conservation and historic preservation concerns, the Council approved a resolution requesting a master plan for the Oak Grove Cemetery expansion and referred it to committee for a report due in February.

items.title: CPA Appropriation Requests
items.summary: The Council approved Community Preservation Act appropriations of $10,000 for emergency roof restoration at the Unitarian Universalist Church and $50,000 in contingency funding for the Condon Shell lighting project.

items.title: Driver's Education Vehicle Lease-Purchase Financing Agreement
items.summary: The Council authorized a five-year lease-purchase financing agreement for a hybrid driver's education vehicle for Medford Public Schools.

items.title: Medford High School Building Project Legal Costs Appropriation
items.summary: The Council approved a $75,000 appropriation from the General Stabilization Fund for legal fees related to the Medford High School building project.

items.title: Roberts Elementary School Roof and Heat Pump Conversion Project
items.summary: The Council approved the Construction Manager at Risk delivery method and a $23,605,562 loan order for the roof replacement and heat pump conversion at Roberts Elementary School.

items.title: FY27 Law Department Supplemental Appropriation and State Audit Request
items.summary: Following extended debate regarding legal spending transparency, the Council approved a $269,295.81 supplemental appropriation for the Law Department and passed a companion resolution asking the Mayor to request a state audit of city legal costs.

items.title: FY27 Tax Classification Hearing
items.summary: Following a presentation by the city assessor, the Council voted against adopting small commercial and residential exemptions and approved a minimum residential factor of 0.908635 to maintain the maximum 175% tax shift onto commercial properties.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents addressed the Council regarding ownership, municipal policy, and legal liability concerns surrounding private ways in Medford.
